original_intake.statement_quote: Prove theta(p_c) = 0 for Bernoulli percolation on Z^d for every d >= 3; open for 3 <= d <= 10
original_intake.warning: The intake does not specify bond versus site. Heydenreich and van der Hofstad, Open Problem 1.1, explicitly focus on bond percolation.

precise_bond_statement: For independent nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d with p_c=inf{p: P_p(|C(0)|=infinity)>0}, P_{p_c}(|C(0)|=infinity)=0 for every integer d>=2.
primary_historical_source: https://rhofstad.win.tue.nl/survey-high-d-percolation.pdf, Open Problem 1.1, printed p. 4; definitions (1.1.1)-(1.1.2) and bond focus on pp. 3-4

new_primary_source.paper_theorems: Theorem 1.1: all infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive undirected graphs with p_c<1; Corollary 10.1: nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d for every d>=2 has no infinite cluster at criticality.
new_primary_source.exact_scope: Infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive labelled-bond graph with criticalProbability < 1; law at criticalProbability gives percolates measure zero.
new_primary_source.comparator: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/math/main/lean/ComparatorChallenges/CriticalPercolation.json: theorem name OAI.CriticalPercolation.BondGraph.no_percolation_at_criticality, permitted axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice, enable_nanoda false.
new_primary_source.formal_check_limit: The comparator file includes a sorry placeholder for the trusted statement; the implementation theorem in Main.lean has a proof term. I have not run Lean or comparator independently and cannot certify the entire dependency chain from these reads alone.
